entries.body: NEW - The enchantment system is here: enchantments fitted to your pickaxes, suits and pets raise your damage, critical hits, gold gain and heat resistance. - Enchantments come in four tiers: Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary; higher tiers mean both stronger effects and more properties on a single enchantment. - Every enchantment rolls its own values the moment it is crafted and never changes again, so no two enchantments of the same tier are alike. - An inventory has been added: everything you collect is kept here. - The Crafter page has been added: you craft enchantments from the dust and pieces that drop while breaking ore. - The Trader and the Crafter now sit as two sub-tabs under the General tab. - Dismantling has been added to the Trader: pick an enchantment you no longer want and turn it back into materials. - Enchantment slot indicators are shown on pickaxe, suit and pet cards; the slots unlock as you go deeper. - Daily missions have been added: complete the missions that refresh every day and collect currency and timed boost rewards. - Floor jumping has been added: the floor selector now moves in 1x, 2x, 5x and 10x steps. - An activity log has been added: everything important that happens shows up as a short notification in the corner and is collected in the log. - You can click the notification to open the log. - An in-game update notes panel has been added: when a new announcement goes live it opens once the next time you start the game. - A shared reward panel has been added: prestige, boss, task, achievement, daily mission, daily reward, wheel, worker collection and purchase rewards are now all listed one by one in the same panel. - Shortcut keys have been added: hold Shift to see the keys on the buttons, then press Shift together with that key to trigger the button. - An indicator showing your prestige level has been added. - A tooltip has been added to the temperature gauge: it shows the temperature at which the effect starts and how much damage you are losing. - Four new readouts have been added to the effect status panel: critical chance, critical damage, gold multiplier and the share transferred from DPS to click damage. - Five new achievements have been added: reaching a given floor, maxing every skill, collecting offline earnings, joining the Discord and collecting a gold crystal. - 38 new rows have been added to the statistics page; almost everything you do in the game now has a visible counter. - Ores have a new surface look with added shine, reflection and sparkle effects. IMPROVEMENTS - Changing the language no longer reloads the game; every text switches instantly without closing your open panel. - All tooltips moved to a single system; tooltips left hanging on screen after a panel closes are gone. - Panels now open hidden for one frame, so you no longer see text and lists jumping into place as they appear. - The health bar moves smoothly every frame, while the health number refreshes less often so it stays readable. - Damage per second is now applied continuously instead of in discrete hits; the health bar and the real health always match. - General performance has been improved: the main panel was moved to its own layer, an unnecessary recalculation on the statistics page was removed and the sound system was made lighter. - Percentage readouts no longer round small values away, and the percent sign now sits on the correct side in every language. - Every multiplier and exponent readout in the game was converted to percentages, leaving a single way to read them. - The DPS abbreviation is now written with each language's own abbreviation. - The privacy text has been rewritten: it clearly states what data is collected, who it is shared with and how you can withdraw consent. - Locked task and worker slots now show which floor the next unlock happens on. - Panel titles were unified into a single shared design. - Save file writing became more reliable on Windows; your save is no longer lost when a virus scan or a cloud sync gets in the way. - A confirmation message is shown when a save is loaded and when progress is reset. - The settings, load save and paste save panels can now be opened on the start screen as well. - Unavailable buttons now appear greyed out, so it is clear at a glance why they do not work. - When picking an enchantment, ones that cannot be fitted to that item are no longer listed at all. - The tier colour of an item is shown in the inventory and in enchantment slots. - The enchantment tooltip now notes in short what each property applies to. - Timed boosts got their own icons; a wheel slice icon now comes straight from the reward itself. - Premium and Infinity sources bought with real money are marked with a coloured label in the effect panel. - Crafting and dismantling now ask for confirmation. - The trade page locks in its values when it opens. - The floor panel button no longer disappears with prestige once it has been unlocked. BALANCE - The prestige reward has been completely rewritten: it is now calculated in proportion to the floor you reached and works the same way at every floor. - Prestige no longer grants gold; essence is the only reward. - The prestige reward starts from floor 100; below that, prestige produces no reward. - The prestige requirement only applies to your first prestige; after that you can prestige whenever you like. - After a prestige you always start from floor 1. - The prestige upgrade cost was simplified and the pacing was retuned. - Titles are now prestige-scoped: they reset on prestige and are earned back as you climb. - Uncollected worker income is cleared on prestige; the prestige confirmation screen lists this among the things that reset. - Enchantments on pickaxes that lock on prestige are removed automatically and stay in your inventory. - Your boss progress is no longer reset on prestige; the bosses you have beaten stay unlocked. - Boss health values were rearranged and the prestige level multiplier was removed from boss rewards. - The ore health and gold curves were rewritten, giving a wavier and more consistent difficulty across your progress. - Critical chance is capped at 100%; prestige upgrades that would go past the cap can no longer be bought, so no essence is wasted. - The pickaxe, suit and pet level bonus is granted at widening intervals and in fixed steps. - Time skip durations are now 8, 16 and 24 hours. - The gold crystal can only be collected in the main mine; if you click it while in the dungeon it stays on screen instead of disappearing. - Collectibles you miss make the next one appear sooner. - Ore broken below the deepest floor you have reached drops fewer enchantment materials. - Enchantment material drop rates were aligned into a single table across all four tiers; dust and pieces now accumulate at the same pace. - Material trades are 10 to 1 at every tier, and dismantling an enchantment returns half of its crafting dust. - Floor thresholds now unlock when you pass the floor, not when you reach it. FIXES - Click and damage counts on the leaderboard not matching your statistics has been fixed; scores are now written from the real saved value. - Pets continuing to swing at nothing after a boss died or a fight was lost has been fixed. - The double shake when clicking an ore has been fixed. - Suit and pet panels showing "Pickaxe" in their title has been fixed. - The Time Reversal skill breaking after a prestige has been fixed. - Floor changes not showing on screen after a time skip has been fixed. - The daily reward badge in the store not appearing until the panel was opened has been fixed. - The freeze when loading a save from the start screen has been fixed. - Refunds sometimes being skipped before completing on a failed payment has been fixed. - Rare ore names not showing in some languages has been fixed. As promised, everyone who opens the game within one week of this update going live receives a one-time gift of 100 diamonds. All you have to do is launch the game during that week. Happy mining!

entries.title: 1.6.13 Major Update — September 6, 2026

entries.body:
In the update I will release within a week, I am making a serious change to the game's balance. I am doing it knowing it will affect the progress you have built, and I want to apologise for that first.

I make this game on my own, so I am writing these lines in my own words.

Looking at the data since launch and at what you have reported, I saw one thing clearly: some numbers did not add up. Some paths were far faster than they should be, while others were needlessly blocked. Instead of patching them one by one, I chose to rework the balance as a whole, because small fixes only postponed the real problem.

What this means is plain: some values you are used to will change. A path you have been taking for a while may work differently, and some gains will be recalculated. Your progress is not being wiped and you are not losing anything you own, but the rhythm of the game is changing. I know this can be unsettling for someone who has played for a long time.

What I can offer in return is this: the game comes out of this change much better. Progression becomes consistent with itself, the late-game bottlenecks open up, and the spots that sped up for no reason early on settle down. This is the version that holds up over the long run.

The same update also brings major content. New systems, new paths of progression and additions I have been working on for a long time arrive with this version. You will find the details in the patch notes on release day.

So that you are not left alone in the middle of this change, every player who opens the game within one week of the update going live will receive 100 diamonds from me, once. I wanted you to have some room to move while you settle into the new balance. All you need to do to claim it is download the update and launch the game within that week.

Thank you for coming this far with me, for reporting the problems and for wanting the game to be better. I am still reading your feedback.

Happy mining!

entries.summary: I reworked the balance as a whole, and every player who opens the game within one week of the update will receive 100 diamonds, once.
entries.title: About the Upcoming Balance Change — August 31, 2026

entries.body: NEW - Added time skip: spend diamonds to advance 2, 4 or 8 hours, with rewards based on your current speed and floor. - A summary panel now shows everything you earned when the skip ends. - Added rare ores: five special ores that appear very rarely and are recorded for good once broken. - Added an achievement for breaking every rare ore. - Added the gold crystal: tap this collectible to summon a timed bonus ore that drops gold as you hit it. - Rare and bonus ores now have a glow effect around them. - Premium now comes in two packages: 7 days and 30 days. - Buying the same premium package again extends its duration; the card tooltip explains this. - While a higher premium package is active the lower one cannot be bought, and the card reads "Higher package active". - Added a worker tooltip showing the level bonus, the current income and the income at the next level. IMPROVEMENTS - Improved performance across the game: closed panels and hidden tabs no longer run in the background. - Trade amounts are now picked as a percentage, and the old 16.7 million cap is gone for good. - The slider and amount field stay locked when you have nothing to convert. - Confirmation windows use a green Yes and a red No, with the colors reversed for irreversible actions. - When you cannot afford something, the missing currency is shown with its icon and the matching store is offered. - Achievements are re-evaluated every time the game starts, so none are left behind. - Statistics are shown on a single, more readable line. - The gold per minute figure is now based on your real hit rate. - The Lucky Spin title and the premium store texts were updated in every language. BALANCE - Panels you have unlocked no longer close after a prestige, and task slots stay open too. - The permanent floor counter now rises even with auto floor off, so worker unlocks are no longer delayed. - Bulk upgrade no longer shows a total above your gold. FIXES - Fixed some paid purchases not being delivered; missing purchases are now recovered when you launch the game. - Fixed upgrade costs turning into a meaningless value at very high levels. - Fixed an achievement staying locked while showing as complete. - Fixed some country and currency matches breaking while Turkish was selected. - Fixed the "no rewards left" message on the wheel showing up empty. - Fixed network errors during feedback submission failing silently. Happy mining!
entries.subtitle: Time skip and rare ores are here!
entries.summary: Time skip, rare ores, the gold crystal, two premium packages and plenty of fixes.
entries.title: 1.5.12 Update Notes — August 23, 2026

entries.body: NEW - Added the Lucky Spin: an 8-slice wheel that refreshes every 3 hours. - 2 free spins per cycle; further spins cost diamonds, and each spin raises the next price. - Won slices stay closed for the cycle; the wheel can be fully cleared. - Rewards include gold, ore stone, Taskium, skill stone, essence, dungeon key, diamonds and timed boosts. - The info icon on the wheel panel shows each reward's count and current win chance. - Slice tooltips show boost effects as percentages and currency rewards as exact amounts. - Added an option to skip the spin animation. - A notification dot appears on the wheel button when a free spin is ready. - Active boosts are listed on screen with their remaining time. IMPROVEMENTS - The gold reward scales with your current floor. - Achievement tooltips now show your progress percentage. - Max conversion in trading is now calculated automatically. - Server maintenance and connection issues now show separate messages. - Translation updates across 18 languages. FIXES - Fixed the task accept button sometimes not showing the price. - Fixed tooltips flickering under the cursor and blocking buttons beneath them. Happy mining!
